subject: Add restart option to create-cluster script (#12885)
reason: The change adds a 'restart' option to utils/create-cluster/create-cluster, a developer convenience shell script for spinning up local test clusters, and updates its usage text. No server code, command, tool binary (valkey-cli, valkey-benchmark, valkey-check-rdb/aof), replication, persistence, or cluster-bus behaviour is touched; the script is not shipped in the builds the fuzzer runs, so no experiment or scenario can reach it. No test is needed.
